tagline.en: One global eSIM, pay-as-you-go credits that never expire — free $1.25 start
tagline.zh: 一张全球eSIM按量付费，余额永不过期，送1.25美元

description.en: Roamless issues a single global eSIM (200+ destinations) with two billing models: Flex pay-as-you-go credits (never expire, from ~$0.58–2.45/GB by region) and 30-day fixed plans. Every new user gets $1.25 credits (~500MB) free; a free 500MB Singapore 30-day plan is listed. Singapore rides SingTel 3G/4G, unlimited hotspot.
description.zh: Roamless 一张全球 eSIM（200+ 目的地）两种计费：Flex 按量余额（永不过期，约 0.58–2.45 美元/GB 按地区）与 30 天固定套餐。新用户送 1.25 美元余额（约 500MB）；官方还挂有新加坡 500MB/30 天免费套餐。新加坡走 SingTel 3G/4G，热点不限。

details.en:
Roamless' model is wallet-first: install the eSIM once, buy Flex credits that never expire and auto-consume per MB anywhere among 200+ destinations, or buy conventional 30-day plans. Official prices (2026-09): Singapore 1GB $3.95, 3GB $6.95, 5GB $9.95, 10GB $15.95; USA 1GB $3.95, 10GB $22.45. Singapore network: SingTel 3G/4G with unlimited hotspot and no speed cap (official destination page).

Free tier: $1.25 starter credits (up to 500MB) for every new user, plus a listed free Singapore 500MB/30-day plan. Also sells Roamless Numbers for calls/SMS.

Community single-user hands-on (2026-09, unverified): Singapore landing IP, residential + broadcast IP mix; speeds not tested.
details.zh:
Roamless 主打钱包制：装一次 eSIM，充 Flex 余额永不过期、在 200+ 目的地按 MB 自动扣费；也可买常规 30 天套餐。官方价（2026-09）：新加坡 1GB 3.95、3GB 6.95、5GB 9.95、10GB 15.95 美元；美国 1GB 3.95、10GB 22.45。新加坡官方页标注 SingTel 3G/4G、热点不限、不限速。

免费额度：每位新用户 1.25 美元起充余额（约 500MB），另有挂出的新加坡 500MB/30 天免费套餐。另有 Roamless Numbers 号码产品供通话短信。

社区单用户实测（2026-09，未核实）：落地新加坡、住宅+广播 IP 混合；速率未测。

bestFor.en: Occasional travellers who prefer pay-per-MB with never-expiring balance over fixed plans.
bestFor.zh: 出行频率不固定、偏好按量付费且余额不过期的用户。

en: $1.25 free starter credits + free SG 500MB plan
zh: 新用户送1.25美元+新加坡500MB免费套餐
免费额度大方，适合试水

en: Pay-as-you-go per-GB can exceed plan pricing
zh: 按量单价可能高于套餐价

plansNote.en: Official destination pages (2026-09-25). Flex per-GB varies by region.
